hints.tr: `hostname` zaten küçük harf verir; yoksa `None` döner.
hints.en: `hostname` already gives lower case; if there is none it returns `None`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def real_host(url):
    host = urlsplit(url).hostname
    return host or ""

for url in ["https://shop.example.com/cart",
            "https://shop.example.com@203.0.113.66/",
            "HTTPS://Shop.Example.com/x",
            "not a url"]:
    print(repr(real_host(url)))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def real_host(url):
    host = urlsplit(url).hostname
    return host or ""

for url in ["https://shop.example.com/cart",
            "https://shop.example.com@203.0.113.66/",
            "HTTPS://Shop.Example.com/x",
            "not a url"]:
    print(repr(real_host(url)))
```
